initial_length.label: Initial telomere length
initial_length.description: Mean telomere length of the founding cells.

initial_length_sd.label: Initial length spread (SD)
initial_length_sd.description: Standard deviation of telomere lengths at t=0.

shortening_rate.label: Replication shortening
shortening_rate.description: End-replication loss per telomere per division.

stress_sensitivity.label: Stress sensitivity
stress_sensitivity.description: Extra loss per division at stress_level = 1.

maintenance_rate.label: Maintenance (telomerase-like)
maintenance_rate.description: Fraction of the maximal length-restoring activity.

maintenance_max_gain.label: Max maintenance gain
maintenance_max_gain.description: Gain per division on the shortest telomere at maintenance_rate = 1.

repair_rate.label: Repair rate
repair_rate.description: Fraction of stress-induced damage that is repaired.

senescence_threshold.label: Senescence threshold
senescence_threshold.description: A cell stops dividing once its *shortest* telomere drops below this.

noise_sd.label: Per-division noise SD
noise_sd.description: Gaussian variability in loss per telomere per division.

senescent_death_rate.label: Senescent death rate
senescent_death_rate.description: Probability that a senescent cell is lost per cycle.

replication_error_rate.label: Replication error rate
replication_error_rate.description: Baseline mutation burden added per division, genome-wide.

oxidative_mutation_sensitivity.label: Oxidative mutation sensitivity
oxidative_mutation_sensitivity.description: Extra mutation burden per division at stress_level = 1, offset by repair_rate.

checkpoint_strength.label: Apoptosis checkpoint strength
checkpoint_strength.description: Probability per cycle that a cell over the mutation threshold is removed; 0 disables the checkpoint.

mutation_threshold.label: Mutation burden threshold
mutation_threshold.description: Burden level above which the apoptosis checkpoint can trigger (only relevant when checkpoint_strength > 0).

repair_rate_mutation_sigma.label: Repair-rate mutation step (SD)
repair_rate_mutation_sigma.description: Per-division Gaussian step size applied to each cell's own heritable repair_rate; 0 = feature unused.

hours_per_cycle.label: Hours per cycle
hours_per_cycle.description: Wall-clock hours one cycle represents (bench-timeline mapping, an assumption not a fit); 0 = unused.

initial_within_cell_sd.label: Within-cell initial length SD
initial_within_cell_sd.description: If > 0, initial_length_sd becomes the between-cell SD and this the extra within-cell SD; 0 = unused.

shortening_rate_cv.label: Shortening-rate CV across cells
shortening_rate_cv.description: If > 0, each founder cell draws a heritable lognormal multiplier (mean 1, this CV) on replication shortening; 0 = unused.

senescence_softness_bp.label: Senescence softness
senescence_softness_bp.description: If > 0, senescence is a logistic hazard in (threshold - shortest telomere) with this scale instead of a hard threshold; 0 = hard.

random_arrest_rate.label: Random arrest rate
random_arrest_rate.description: Length-independent per-cycle arrest probability of proliferating cells; 0 = unused.

reserve.description: normalised shortest-telomere reserve at the end

genome_instability.description: genomic instability index (fraction of cells over the mutation threshold)

canalization.description: consistency of survival across replicate seeds (1 - scaled coefficient of variation)
